## 3. Editorial metadata

Summaries, similar questions, context notes, tags and weights attached to each passage are commentary
written for OpenCouncil, some of it drafted with a language model (the `metadataSource` field says
which). They are not quotations. They are licensed under CC BY 4.0.

## 4. Emblems

The emblems in `apps/web/public/emblems/` were made for OpenCouncil with an image-generation model and
are licensed under CC BY 4.0. They are symbols drawn from each thinker's works, not likenesses.

## 5. Disclaimer

Scriptures and philosophical texts are presented for reflection, not as religious, medical, legal or
other professional advice. Translations are historical public-domain ones and may read as dated. The
council's explanations are generated by a language model from the quoted passages and can be wrong;
the quotations are the part you can check.
